_note: Seed thresholds from adversarial observations in muse-room. Every value carries a 'source' so the perf guild's measured knees can replace them traceably. Owned by load-calendar budget checker (worker w3).

degradation_signals._note: If any signal fires during a probe window, all active intents must ramp down to zero immediately (convention rule 4: stop at first degradation).

any_write_s.unit: seconds; any single production write slower than this

board_read_p50_s.unit: seconds; production board read p50 exceeds this

mint_hangs.unit: boolean; identity mint hangs instead of returning 429

identity_mint_rps_aggregate.unit: rps sustained, summed across ALL guilds; scratch targets only

per_guild_production_rps.unit: rps sustained per guild on production targets (max simultaneous across that guild's overlapping windows)

per_guild_production_total_per_window.unit: requests per guild per overlapping window set on production targets

production_claim_update_allowed.unit: count — production claim updates are not allowed (136s hang observed)

production_read_rps_aggregate.unit: rps sustained, summed across ALL guilds

production_write_flood_mint_scratch_only.unit: boolean — kinds write/flood/mint must target scratch only; any production instance is a violation

production_write_rps_aggregate.unit: rps sustained, summed across ALL guilds; kinds write+flood on production targets
